name: AbracaDABra 4.3.0
body:
- Command line interface (CLI) implemented by @Styne13 (check documentation for details) (#239)
	- headless operation
	- web UI
	- CLI UI
- RTL-TCP
	- support for bandwidth selection when server supports it (server by old-dab)
	- connection timeout handling improved
- SDRplay
	- SW AGC redesigned to improve application stability and to fix various device-hang issues
- Pause/resume possibility when scanner runs in endless mode (infinite number of cycles)
- Scanner table follows the last row by default
- Application remembers the last file format that was loaded in scanner (JSON or CSV)
- Option to show only current ensemble in the tree
- Slideshow image scaling is configurable (#336)
- Timestamp added in SLS/SPI data storage patterns
- SNR plot X axis shows system time (#236)
- SNR statistics shows in signal view - application evaluates min/max SNR since the tune or since user opens the signal view
- TII recording icon aligned with audio recording icon (#326 )
- RadioDNS optimisations (#310)

name: AbracaDABra 4.2.1
body:
- settings layout fixed
- transmitters marked as local are removed from scanner map
- German translation fixed (Issue #332)

name: AbracaDABra 4.2.0
body:
General:
- new option to show widget on Service page (TII of Spectrum is supported). This feature requires certain space so it will not show when the window is too small or on a mobile phone. Widget shares settings with the respective page.
- French translation thanks to Lucas Gallone
- support for compressed MOT objects

Android:
- lock screen widget showing service logo if available
- data storage selection is triggered automatically on the first use when access rights are not granted (typically after new installation). When a user tries to save anything for the first time, the application asks the user to select a storage folder. This is to avoid using application private storage that is difficult to access by file manager (issue #320)

Input devices:
- RTL-TCP redesigned, it should perform better with official RTL-SDR server running on Windows
- RTL-SDR/TCP PPM correction range extended to +-300

Signal view:
- waterfall implemented - optional, enabled from menu

Scanner + TII
- receiver location (blue dot) on map is rendered on top (it will not be covered by transmitter markers)
- option to export CSV table headers in English (for better compatibility with 3rd party tools, like the analyser from Lucas)
- TX coordinates, altitude and antenna height is exported to CSV when the GPS coordinates option is enabled. RX altitude is exported too.
- incremental scan mode - application records only changes and new transmitters
- table shows ensemble country flags (internet connection is required)
- application captures ensemble structure in all scanning modes although it may be incomplete in fast and normal mode
- new JSON format to store scanner results introduced. This format stores all the information including ensemble structure. It can be loaded by application later. Auto-save option is also available but unlike CSV, JSON is stored automatically when scan stops.

name: AbracaDABra 4.1.1
body:
Bug fixes:
- DABSDR 4.0.1 (fixes issue #304)
- scanner table sorting by RF level (Issue #305)
- connection to RTL-TCP server by Osmocom shall work with some limitations (issue #301)
- service list restoring from backup
- update dialog
- SoapySDR device redesigned, SDRplay devices are slower to reduce possibility of API server hangs

name: AbracaDABra 4.1.0
body:
- optional NULL spectrum can be enabled in DAB signal view
- color coding of SNR values depend on current audio service protection level
- possibility do delete ensemble and its services from service tree - drag ensemble name to the left (swipe left on Android) and delete button appears (Issue #265)
- possibility to backup and restore settings (settings, service list and audio recording schedule)
- DAB scanning tool saves GPS location when enabled in settings->TII but when the CSV is loaded into the application, only first GPS location is considered. Application shows this GPS location as blue dot in the map.
- DAB scanning tool is available without HW connection to allow inspecting CSV logs in „offline mode“
- RF level is stored in DAB scanning tool results table/CSV (Issue #300)
- frequency offset correction (PPM) is saved per device for RTL-SDR and SDRplay. Correct functionality requires different RTL-SDR device ID (to be sure, to set different serial number for each device)
- filtering/searching in the service list - use Cmd+F/Ctrl+F or start typing on desktop, drag the service list down on Android
- DABSDR 4.0.0 with some bug fixes (#268) and (hopefully) more reliable synchronisation r
- keyboard shortcuts (documentation: https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra#keyboard-shortcuts), support for global media keys including control from bluetooth devices like headsets or speakers (Issue #233) 
- audio recording schedule feature removed on Android
- new Italian translation (thanks to Michele Rizzelli)
- many bug fixes and small improvements

name: AbracaDABra 4.0.1
body:
**Bugfixes**
- DL messages recording while recording audio
- Android notification is visible when audio plays (Issue #291)
- Slow scanner CSV loading
- Some SDRplay hang issues could be resolved

**Improvements**
- Android notification shows service name and DL
- Dark theme colors tuned for better readability
- DL links detection
- Tray icon on Linux (Issue #292)
- EPG in mobile view improved

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/compare/v4.0.0...v4.0.1

name: AbracaDABra 4.0.0
body:
Changes from 3.3.2:

* fresh and modern UI based on QML
* single window design but most of the views can be detached to separate window (use Cmd+Click/Ctrl+Click on left navigation bar or button in the view to detach the window)
* all files are stored in subfolder to the location that you can select in Settings -> Others
* minimum Qt version is 6.7
* Android build available (Android 11 or newer, arm64-v8a required)
* Input devices
    - RTL-SDR option to disable RF level estimation (mostly useful on cheap Android devices)
    - Selection of 4096kHz / 3072 kHz sample rate for Airspy (mostly useful on Android)
    - Possibility to disconnect device
* TII
    - table columns on map are customisable
    - application remembers sorting column and order
    - information on map is more compact
* Scanner
    - CSV auto save is performed during scanning (Issue #228)
* SPI
    - SPI logos are stored for each bearer (Issue #278) -> new structure of application cache, recommended to delete existing cache
    - Handling of programme going over midnight in EPG (Issue #272)
    - Logos are downloaded automatically when RadioDNS is enabled
* Others
    - UPC cable channels (Issue #251)
    - When static PTy is not available, application upload dynamic PTy to FMLIST (Issue #286)
    - Many changes under the hood and small fixes
    - Possibility do navigate in service list by pressing first letter of the service name (favorites are ignored)

Note: Settings is mostly forward compatible from 3.3.2 to 4.0.0 but backward compatibility is not guaranteed.

Changes from 4.0.0 RC1:
* more reliable RadioDNS specifically for Android
* possibility to navigate in service list by pressing letters on keyboard
* application remembers TII and Scanner table sorting and possibility to create TII log with at least signal quality when no TII is decoded
* Audio is no longer lost when frequency offset is changed
* Some small improvements and fixes of UI

name: AbracaDABra v3.99.2 (4.0.0 RC1)
body:
* Input devices
   - RTL-SDR option to disable RF level estimation (shall fix issue https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/issues/273)
   - RTL-TCP reverted to native socket implementation (issue https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/issues/288)
* Android
   - Option to keep screen on
   - UI scaling on some Lenovo devices
   - Missing audio after signal loss under Android fixed (Issue https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/issues/287)
   - Long press on scanner table to show context menu
* UI
   - Navigation bar in compact view does not display lables
   - Non-intrusive status messages implemented
* Others
   - When static PTy is not available, application upload dynamic PTy to FMLIST (Issue https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/issues/286)
   - Reset FIB/MSC stats from context menu (long press on Android) (Issue https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra/issues/274)
   - Apply button for GPS coordinates
   - Scanner import/export functionality fixed
   - Small improvements and fixes

Note: Android 11 or newer on ARM64 device is supported

name: AbracaDABra v3.99.1 (4.0.0 beta 2)
body:
* Input devices
	- RTL-TCP input redesigned
	- RTL-SDR inpit stabilization for Android
	- Possibility to disconnect device
	- Selection of 4096kHz / 3072 kHz sample rate for Airspy (mostly
	  useful on Android)
* TII
	- table columns on map are customizable
	- information on map is more compact
* Scanner
	- CSV auto save is performed during scanning (Issue #228)
* SPI
	- SPI logos are stored for each bearer (Issue #278) -> new structure of application cache, recommended to delete
	  existing cache
	- Handling of programme going over midnight in EPG (Issue #272)
	- Logos are downloaded automatically when RadioDNS is enabled
* Others
	- many UI improvements
	- compact view added
	- detached windows behavior on Windows
	- UPC cable channels (Issue #251)
	- possibility to change item on combo by mouse wheel
	- Secondary services are automatically expanded in the tree (Issue #279)

* Many small improvements and bug fixes

**WARNING:** This is beta version, especially on Android, problems to be expected. This version changes service logos application cache structure, it is recommended to delete the cache to avoid duplicate entries.

name: AbracaDABra v3.99.0 (4.0.0 beta 1)
body:
This is first public release after major application UI redesign. There are almost no new features, but everything in UI has been redesigned from the scratch so problems and bugs to be expected. It is highly recommended to backup current settings and service list before experimenting with this version. Feel free to report any problem you will find. 

Changes:
- fresh and modern UI based on QML
- single window design but most of the views can be detached to separate window (use Cmd+Click/Ctrl+Click on left navigation bar or button in the view to detach the window)
- all files are stored in subfolder to the location that you can select in Settings -> Others
- minimum Qt version is 6.7
- Android build available (Android 11 or newer, arm64-v8a required) - this is more like alpha version, be careful

name: AbracaDABra 3.3.0
body:
* Main window
    - Optional country flags for ensemble and service can be shown (internet connection is required) (#195)
    - Option to show system time when DAB time is not available
    - Adjustable SLS / DL(+) layout - border between SLS and DL(+) can be moved up and down 
* Devices
    - RF level correction for RTL-SDR and RTL-TCP (it can be used to compensate LNA gain)
    - Runtime change of SDRplay device antenna input (user feedback needed) (#211)
    - *.iq files are added in supported extension lists for Raw file input
* TII 
    - Map position and zoom is persistent
* Scanning tool
    - UI redesign - some features were moved to three dots menu
    - SNR indication added 
    - Option disable clearing of previous scan results on starting new scan (#218)
    - Transmitters can be marked as local (known) by right clicking on the table row
    - Automatic saving of the CSV log on scan stop (#222)
* Ensemble information dialog
    - FIB and MSC statistics redesigned - RS BER estimation added for AAC services
* Audio
    - Detection of AAC stream drop-outs
    - Selection between FAAD and FDK-AAC decoder
    - New "Default audio device" added in audio output selection
* Bug fixes and UI polishing

name: AbracaDABra 3.2.0
body:
* DABSDR version 3.1.0 with bitrate stats
* Ensemble info dialog was redesigned

    * Color bar showing subchannel allocation in ensemble
    * Subchannel details
* Option to use UTC for scanner and TII CSV log
* Option to export GPS coordinates in TII CSV log
* NMEA serial port baudrate is configurable (#176)
* All dialog windows are taken for front when main window is activated from taskbar
* Ensemble logo from SPI is supported - shown in main window and as a ensemble tool tip in service list (#168)

name: AbracaDABra 3.1.0
body:
* Application remembers last opened windows and can restore them on start (#196)
* Signal overview
    - Spectrum refresh rate configurable
    - SNR value can be displayed as large text beside the plot
* TII dialog can be configured to show no longer detected transmitters as gray bubbles with optional timeout
* Optional IQ raw file recording timeout
* SPI progress icon can be set to be persistent
* Service logo is displayed in service list tooltips
* Confirmation dialog pops-up before clearing service list
* Polish translation updated
* Bug fixes

name: AbracaDABra 3.0.0
body:
* Input devices
    - Support for SDRplay devices added (API 3.15 is required) (#158)
    - RTL-SDR/Airspy/SDRplay device can be selected before connection
    - RTL-SDR added new Driver AGC mode, this is AGC controlled by RTL-SDR driver implemented by old-dab (#188)
* RF level estimation on supported devices 
* DAB Signal overview with signal spectrum plot, SNR plot and other signal parameters
* FMLIST ensemble CSV upload (#5)
* Scanner tool can load previously stored CSV files to display data in dialog
* SPI application loading progress is indicated in the application window 
* Audio output framework can be switched between Qt and PortAudio from Settings
* TII detection 
    - Spectrum visualization modified to show carrier pairs
    - TII detector can be configured as more sensitive or more reliable (#183)    
    - When more transmitters in the ensemble network use the same TII code, application chooses the one that is more likely received (#189)
* Settings
    - INI is split, service list and audio recording schedule were moved to separate JSON files
    - Service list JSON can be set as command line switch
    - Service list can be exported as CSV file

**Special thanks:**
- to AndrejH for lending me his RSP1A device to implement SDRplay support. This wouldn't have been possible without your help!
- to Herman Wijnants and Bernhard Kistinger for testing, patience and their valuable feedback

**WARNING: On the first run, the application upgrades the settings file (INI) in a way that is not compatible with older versions. It is recommended to backup your [settings](https://github.com/KejPi/AbracaDABra?tab=readme-ov-file#expert-settings) if you want to run older versions of the application.**

name: AbracaDABra 2.7.0
body:
* DABSDR v2.6.1 with improved TII detection
* Improved handling of named pipes (FIFO) as raw file input under macOS and Linux
* Unknown TCP server can be connected as RTL-TCP device (passing raw stream over TCP)
* Zoom in/out buttons in TII map added
* Partial support for ETSI TS 102 371 V1.x.x (old EPG standard; BBC case)
* Detection of URLs in DL messages (copy DL message to clipboard is by right click now)
* Slideshow background is customisable from settings (default is black, any color including transparent background is supported)

name: AbracaDABra 2.6.0
body:
* Requires Qt version >= 6.5.0 for full functionality
* TII detection added
* DAB transmitters shown on map (database provided by FMLIST, many thanks to Günter Lorenz)
* Application-wide proxy configuration used for transmitter map, RadioDNS and FMLIST database update
* Possibility to seek raw files from Settings dialog
* Optional recording of DL messages during audio recording (Issue #129)
* SNR Plot (click on dB value in main window) (QCustomPlot library is required)
* EPG icon for fast access (Issue #146)
* WAV files can be loaded as RAW files input (Issue #140)
* Ensemble information, Application log and CatSLS dialogs remember their geometry (Issue #151)
* Optional tray icon with possibility to mute/unmute the audio output added
* Ensemble information can be exported in CVS format
* Many fixes and improvements
* MacOS binaries require macOS 11 or newer
